description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Create a revocable preview for a post, sample, campaign, section or calendar. Anyone holding the URL may view/comment. Approval requires a human session with brand approval rights or a private emailed code; never ask your human to give you their code. Give the human previewUrl immediately: it is returned once. No configured human approver means view/comment-only.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/approval-previews.)

contentIds.description: Saved content IDs for post (one) or sample previews.

to.description: Exclusive calendar end; at most 31 days after from.

name: create_approval_preview
title: Share content for human approval
